item.title: Rare air for Christmas could break records in the Ozarks
item.description: Temperatures will remain chilly with filtered sunshine this weekend, before rising to near record highs in the low to mid 70s for the week of Christmas.

item.title: Henry County man sentenced with involuntary manslaughter in woman’s shooting
item.description: Harold James, 75, was sentenced to probation after his significant other, Jody James, was found dead on June 17, with James claiming he shot her in self-defense after an argument over a property dispute.

item.title: Windy weather leaves hundreds in Missouri without power
item.description: MISSOURI — Towns in Ozark, Howell, and Douglas counties have reported power outages after winds caused trouble with power lines on Thursday, Dec. 18. item.title: National Twin Day: Meet the twins of Ozarks First
item.description: On National Twin Day, Ozarks First spoke to twins Jamie Warriner, Michael McLaughlin, Kaleb Fobair, and Kathyrn Skopec about their experiences growing up with a twin.

item.title: Man arrested after wrong-way crash leaves one dead in Howell County
item.description: Jason Morgan, 40, of Marionville, was arrested and charged with DWI resulting in the death of another and leaving the scene of an accident resulting in death after a fatal two-vehicle crash near Pomona, MO.
